z-k-01-01.title: Ngaba ibhili ihambelana neodolo?
z-k-01-01.goal: Hlola incoko emfutshane yokuodola ngokuchasene nemenyu, ufumane umgca wokuqala onesixa esingahambelaniyo, uyilele iodolo zakho ezifanelana nohlahlo-lwabiwo-mali oluzinzileyo.
z-k-01-01.material:
Ikhefi encinci ineli menyu (원 = won, imali yaseKorea).
커피 한 잔: 3,000원
빵 한 개: 2,000원

손님 = umthengi, 직원 = umthengisi. Funda incoko.

손님: 커피 두 잔 주세요.
직원: 네. 커피 두 잔, 6,000원이에요.
손님: 그리고 빵 세 개 주세요.
직원: 네. 빵 세 개, 5,000원이에요.
직원: 모두 11,000원이에요.
z-k-01-01.thinking.1: Ukufumana apho impazamo iqala khona nento eyidlulisayo
z-k-01-01.thinking.2: Ukuvelisa iiodolo ezininzi ezahlukeneyo ezihlangabezana neemida ezifanayo
z-k-01-01.prereq.1: Uyazi amagama okubala 한, 두, 세, 다섯 ... ne-개 kunye 잔
z-k-01-01.s.s1.prompt: Ngumphi umgca OWOKUQALA onesixa esingahambelaniyo nemenyu?
z-k-01-01.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha into enye ngexesha: fumana ixabiso layo kwimenyu, uze ulithelekise nesixa umthengisi asithethayo.
z-k-01-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola umgca we-커피 kuqala ukuze ubone ukuba umgca ochanekileyo unjani, emva koko uhlole umgca we-빵 ngendlela efanayo.
z-k-01-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-4 yimpazamo yokuqala: 빵 yi-2,000원 enye, ngoko izonka ezintathu zi-6,000원, hayi i-5,000원. Umgca wesi-2 ulungile (iikofu ezimbini ngama-3,000원). Umgca wesi-5 udibanisa umgca wesi-2 nowesi-4 ngokuchanekileyo, kodwa uqala kwisixa sesonka esingachanekanga, ngoko ukwaphosakele; asiyiyo impazamo eyahlukileyo.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.prompt: Umthengi uza kuhlawula isixa esikumgca wokugqibela. Umbhali ebefanele ukuthi ntoni kumgca wokugqibela?
z-k-01-01.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana isixa esichanekileyo kwinto nganye ngokwahlukeneyo.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.hint.1: Emva koko thelekisa okupheleleyo ne-11,000원 kwibhili.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.r.a: Usenokuba ufunde 세 개 njenge-두 개. Thelekisa inani umthengi alithethileyo nelo olisebenzisileyo.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.r.b: Oku kuphinda izixa zomthengisi ngokwakhe. Isixa sichanekile, kodwa esinye sezixa esakhiwe kuzo asichanekanga.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.r.c: Oku kuvela ekuhloleni into nganye ngokuchasene nemenyu kuqala kwaye emva koko kudityaniswe izixa.
z-k-01-01.s.s2.explain: Ikofu 2 x 3,000 = 6,000 kwaye isonka 3 x 2,000 = 6,000, ngoko isixa sizonke yi-12,000원. I-11,000원 yomthengisi sisixa esichanekileyo sesixa sesonka esingachanekanga.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.prompt: Unazo ngqo ezi-13,000원 kwaye ufuna ukuzichitha zonke kwi-커피 (c iikomityi) kunye 빵 (b iziqwenga). Odola ubuncinane enye yenye nenye kwaye ubuninzi izinto ezi-6 zizonke. Fumana iiodolo ezimbini ezahlukeneyo.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha ukuba zingaphi iikofu kuqala, emva koko ubone ukuba imali eseleyo yesonka ingakanani.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ukuba imali eseleyo ayiyonani eliphindaphindiweyo le-2,000, tshintsha inani leekofu.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.ok.c1: Amanani apheleleyo, ubuncinane enye yenye nenye.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Sebenzisa amanani apheleleyo, nobuncinane ikomityi enye newonke.
z-k-01-01.s.s3.explain: Iiodolo ezimbini ziyasebenza: 커피 1 + 빵 5 (3,000 + 10,000) kunye 커피 3 + 빵 2 (9,000 + 4,000). Nge-커피 2 ibhili yi-12,000원, kwaye 커피 5 sele ibiza ngaphezulu kwe-13,000원 kunye nesonka esinye.
z-k-01-01.s.s4.prompt: Yithi enye yee-oda zakho kumthengisi, ngesiKorea. Sebenzisa zozibini izinto, amagama azo okubala, kunye ne-주세요.
z-k-01-01.s.s4.hint.0: Yitha inxalenye yekofu kuqala, emva koko inxalenye yesonka, uze ugqibe nge-주세요.
z-k-01-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ingaba i-oda yam isebenzisa amanani enye yee-oda zam ezimbini zenyathelo langaphambili?
z-k-01-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ingaba 커피 ihamba ne-잔 kwaye 빵 ihamba ne-개?
z-k-01-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Ingaba umthengisi wayeza kwazi kanye oko kufuneka akuzise?

z-k-01-02.thinking.1: Ukuphinda ugqibe xa ulwazi olutsha lufika
z-k-01-02.title: Ngubani utitshala kule klasi?
z-k-01-02.goal: Ncitshisa ukuba ngubani utitshala usuka kwizintshayelelo ezimfutshane, uqaphele xa isivakalisi esitsha siphikisana nempendulo yakho, uze ubhale isivakalisi esilungisa ingxabano.
z-k-01-02.material: Abantu abathathu bakwiklasi yesiKorea: 민호, 에밀리 no-켄. Omnye wabo ngutitshala; abanye ababini ngabafundi. Umntu ngamnye unobumi obunye kuphela (한국 사람 = umKorea, 미국 사람 = uMmelika). Wonke umntu uthetha inyaniso kwiingcebiso ezimbini zokuqala. Iingcebiso ziza enye emva kwenye.
z-k-01-02.prereq.2: Uyawazi amagama 학생, 선생님, 한국 사람, 미국 사람
z-k-01-02.s.s1.prompt: Emva kwesingcebiso ngasinye, khetha ingcinga enengqiqo kakhulu.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.hint.0: Phambi kokukhetha, yitha ngamazwi akho ukuba isivakalisi ngasinye sifaka ngaphakathi okanye sigxothe ntoni.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.hint.1: Emva kwesingcebiso ngasinye esitsha, khangela ukuba siyahambelana na nayo yonke into osele uyazi.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.0.after: 아니에요 isusa 에밀리 kuphela. Zombini 민호 no-켄 zisenokwenzeka.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ubona ukuba enye 'ayikho' isusa umntu omnye kwaye iyawashiya amanye evulekile.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uthatha 'hayi 에밀리' njenge-'kufuneka abe 켄' nangona kungekho nto ithethwayo ngo-민호.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Utitshala ngumKorea, 켄 ngumMelika kwaye 에밀리 uthe akangutitshala, ngoko kushiyeke 민호.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uphosa ukuba 켄 uthi utitshala ngumKorea ngelixa yena ngumMelika.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ibeka isingcebiso 1 (hayi 에밀리) kunye nesingcebiso 2 (utitshala ngumKorea, 켄 ngumMelika).
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukuba wonke umntu uthetha inyaniso, akukho namnye onokuba nguTitshala: 에밀리 akangoye, 켄 akangomKorea, kwaye 민호 uthi ungumfundi. Ngoko isivakalisi esinye asilunganga okanye asiqondwanga kakuhle. Ukubuza kwakhona, okanye ukugcina 민호 ngokuqiniseka okuncinci, zombini zilungile; ukungakhathali isingcebiso akulunganga.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Gcina 민호 njengentelekelelo yam engcono, kodwa umbuze kwakhona.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Igcina impendulo exhaswe kakhulu kodwa inciphisa ukuqiniseka kwaye ikhangela umthombo.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Iingcebiso azinakuba ziyinyani zonke. Ndiza kukhangela oko umntu ngamnye awathethayo ngokwenene.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ubona ukuba izivakalisi ezine ziyaphikisana, ngoko isivakalisi esithile asilunganga okanye asiqondwanga kakuhle.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ngu-켄 utitshala emva kwayo yonke. Ubumi bakhe abubalulekanga.
z-k-01-02.s.s1.reflect: Isingcebiso sokuqala sasusa umntu omnye, sesibini sakhetha omnye, kwaye sesithathu saphikisana nokhetho. Ingxabano phakathi kweengcebiso nayo yinkcazelo: ikuxelela ukuba ukhangele izivakalisi endaweni yokukhetha impendulo oyithandayo.
z-k-01-02.s.s2.prompt: Bhala isivakalisi esinye sesiKorea apho 민호 anokuthi endaweni ye-'저는 학생이에요', ukuze zonke iingcebiso zihambelane kwaye abe nguTitshala.
z-k-01-02.s.s2.hint.0: Lisiphi igama kwisivakalisi sokugqibela sika-민호 eliphikisana neengcebiso ezinye?
z-k-01-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tshintsha eli gama kuphela uze ugcine isiphelo -이에요.
z-k-01-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba isivakalisi sam senza 민호 abe nguTitshala?
z-k-01-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba sisaphikisana nokuba 민호 ngumKorea kunye nezinye iingcebiso?
z-k-01-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Iphinda ubumi bakhe, emva koko inyani entsha.

z-k-01-11.title: Isaziso esinokufundwa ngeendlela ezimbini
z-k-01-11.goal: Fumana oko isaziso sikuthethayo ngokuqinisekileyo phantsi kokufunda kwaso kwombini, hlaziya uluvo lwakho njengoko iinyani zifika, fumana amanani okubakho ahambelanayo, uze ubhale kwakhona isaziso ukuze kuseleyo uhlobo olunye lokufunda.
z-k-01-11.material:
Iklabhu inamalungu ali-10 (umongameli weklabhu 회장 elinye lamalungu ali-10). Umthetho weklabhu (ngesiNgesi): intlanganiso inokubanjwa kuphela ukuba ubuncinane amalungu angama-6 kwali-10 eza. Isaziso sasolulwa emva kosuku lwentlanganiso:
“오늘 회의에는 회원이 모두 참석하지 않았습니다.”
Isivakalisi sinokufundwa ngeendlela ezimbini. Ufundo A: akukho lungu eliweze. Ufundo B: ayizange wonke amalungu eze (ezinye zeza, ezinye azange). Iinyani zifika enye ngenye.
z-k-01-11.thinking.0: Ukubona ukuba isivakalisi sinokuba neendlela ezimbini zokufunda
z-k-01-11.prereq.0: Uyazi 모두 (bonke) kunye 아무도 / 한 명도 (akukho namnye)
z-k-01-11.prereq.1: Uyazi okukhanyayo -지 않다 kunye nesimbo esisemthethweni -습니다
z-k-01-11.s.s1.prompt: Emva kwecandelo ngalinye lolwazi, khetha umcimbi onengqiqo kakhulu.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.hint.0: Buza ukuba yintoni eyinyani kuFundo A nakuFundo B, uze ugcine kuphela leyo iyinyani kuzo zombini.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.hint.1: Emva kwenyani nganye, jonga ukuba lufundo luni olichasayo.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.after: Phantsi kuka-A wonke umntu wayengekho kwaye phantsi kuka-B abanye babengekho, ngoko 'ubuncinane ilungu elinye lalingekho' liyinyani kuzo zombini. Akukho enye into eqinisekileyo okwangoku.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ikhetha ufundo A ngokungathi lolona lukhoyo.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ifumana oko ukufunda kombini kwabelana ngako: A no-B bobabini bashiya umntu ngaphandle.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.info: Wonke umntu uyavuma ukuba umongameli weklabhu (회장) wayekho entlanganisweni.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukuba umongameli weza, 'akukho lungu eliweze' lubuxoki. Ufundo B, 'ezinye zeza, ezinye azange', lusaseleyo.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ufundo B: ezinye zeza kwaye ezinye azange.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukubakho komongameli kuhambelana no-B, ngoko u-B akakhutshiwe.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Isebenzisa inyani yokuba ilungu leza ukukhupha 'akukho namnye owaweze'.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zingaphi amalungu aweze, usebenzisa umthetho weklabhu?
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.2.after: Ubuncinane 1 weza (umongameli) nangaphantsi kwama-6 (kungenjalo intlanganiso ibinokubanjwa), ngoko 1 ukuya kwi-5.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ilibala ukuba intlanganiso ifuna ubuncinane abangama-6 ukuze ibanjwe.
z-k-01-11.s.s1.reflect: Impendulo yokuqala ibikhuselekile kuba ibambe kuzo zombini iindlela zokufunda. Inyani entsha nganye isuse ithuba elinye yakwenza ukuba ucace ngakumbi. Awuzange ufune ukuthelekelela ufundo lombhali ukuze uthi eyiphi inyani.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.prompt: Nika amanani amabini okubakho anokwenzeka ahambelana nazo zonke iinyani ezintathu: x amalungu aweze kwaye y amalungu ayengekho (10 ngokupheleleyo). Amanani omabini kufuneka abe nawo amaxabiso ahlukeneyo e-x.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngelona nani liphantsi nelona liphezulu iinyani eziyivumelayo.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.hint.1: Emva koko hlola isixa kunye ne-y.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.ok.c4: Ngaphantsi kwama-6 aweze, ngoko intlanganiso ayinakubanjwa.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.fail.c4: Ama-6 okanye ngaphezulu ebeya kwanela ukubamba intlanganiso.
z-k-01-11.s.s2.explain: Nayiphi na x ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-5 iyasebenza (ngo-y = 10 - x). U-0 ukhutshiwe kuba umongameli weza, kwaye ama-6 okanye ngaphezulu akhutshiwe kuba intlanganiso ayibanjwanga.
z-k-01-11.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kwakhona isaziso ngesiKorea kabini: isivakalisi esinye esinokuthetha kuphela 'akukho lungu eliweze', nesinye esinokuthetha kuphela 'akuzange wonke amalungu eze'.

z-k-01-11.s.s3.hint.1: Kwi-'hayi wonke umntu', yitsho ukuba ngubani owayeza okanye ukuba 'akuyonto yokuba bonke beza'.
z-k-01-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Isivakalisi sam sokuqala sithetha kuphela ukuba akukho namnye weza?
z-k-01-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Isivakalisi sam sesibini sithetha kuphela ukuba ezinye azizanga?

z-k-01-04.title: Yeyiphi esi-3 isitishi??
z-k-01-04.topic: Ukunika nokulandela izikhokelo kumgca wesikhululo sikaloliwe osemhlabeni
z-k-01-04.goal: Gqiba ukuba izikhokelo zomhlobo zishiya ntoni zivulekile, sebenzisa imiyalezo emitsha ukuncitshisa amathuba, uze ubuze imibuzo elahlekileyo ngesiKorea.
z-k-01-04.material:
민아 uya esikolweni sika-지우 ngesikhululo sikaloliwe. Umgca 2 uyema ngolu landelelwano, ukusuka ekhohlo ukuya ekunene:
가역 - 나역 - 다역 - 라역 - 마역 - 바역 - 사역
Ikhaya lika-민아 likufuphi ne-라역, ngoko ukhwela ku-라역. 지우 uthumela imiyalezo emibini. Ifika enye emva kwenye.
z-k-01-04.prereq.0: Uyazi 타세요 / 내리세요 kunye ne-세 번째
z-k-01-04.s.s1.prompt: Emva komyalezo ngamnye, khetha ingcinga enengqiqo kakhulu.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala izikhululo emgceni uphawule i-라역. Bala ukuya esikhululweni sesithathu kwicala ngalinye.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.hint.1: Phambi kokukhetha, zibuze ukuba 지우 wayeza kufuna ukongeza ntoni ukwenza isikhululo esinye kuphela sibe nokwenzeka.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ingaba 민아 angaqiniseka ukuba kufuneka ehle phi?
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukuba i-라역 ngokwayo ayibalwa, isikhululo sesithathu yi-가역 ekhohlo kunye ne-사역 ekunene. Isalathiso silahlekile.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ewe: 'esithathu isitishi' sibiza isikhululo esinye kuphela.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ibala kwicala elinye kuphela iphose ukuba umgca uya macala omabini.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ubona ukuba isikhululo sesithathu ekhohlo nasekunene zizikhululo ezahlukileyo.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hayi: umyalezo awuthi uhambo luthatha imizuzu emingaphi.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ikhangela inkcukacha engenakutshintsha ukuba sesiphi isikhululo sesithathu.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Sesiphi isikhululo 'esithathu isikhululo' ku-민아, okhwela ku-라역?
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Abathethi abaninzi abayibali indawo ekhwelwa kuyo, nto leyo enika i-사역; abanye bayibala, nto leyo enika i-바역. Ukukhetha i-사역 yintelekelelo elungileyo, kwaye ukungaqiniseki nako kunengqiqo. Eyona ndlela ikhuselekileyo kukubuza.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Iqala ukubala ngesikhululo esilandelayo emva koko okhwela kuso.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ibala indawo ekhwelwa kuyo njengendawo yokuqala.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Andikwazi ukuqiniseka: kuxhomekeke ekubeni i-라역 ngokwayo iyabalwa na.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ubona ukuba zimbini iindlela zokubala kwaye akukho nanye ixeliweyo.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Oku kukuxelela ntoni ngendlela 지우 abale ngayo?
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Isikolo sikwi-사역. Kuphela ukubala 마역 (1), 바역 (2), 사역 (3) kufikelela kuyo, ngoko 지우 akayibalanga indawo ekhwelwa kuyo.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ukuba kwakunjalo, isikhululo sesithathu sasiya kuba yi-바역, hayi isikhululo sesikolo.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Isikhululo sesikolo sibonisa ukuba ukubala kuni kunika isikhululo esichanekileyo.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 지우 akayibalanga i-라역, isikhululo ekhwelwa kuso.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Isebenzisa isikhululo sesikolo ukugqiba phakathi kweendlela zokubala ezimbini.
z-k-01-04.s.s1.reflect: Umyalezo wokuqala washiya isalathiso sivulekile, owesibini washiya ukubala kuvulekile, kwaye owesithathu wagqiba ukubala. Qaphela ukuba impendulo nganye yayikhuselekile kuphela ngokuba uthe awukayazi.
z-k-01-04.s.s2.prompt: Ekuqaleni, 민아 wayenomyalezo wokuqala kuphela. Bhala umbuzo (imibuzo) wesiKorea anokuthumela ukuze afumane iinyani zombini ezilahlekileyo.
z-k-01-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala umbuzo omnye wenyani nganye elahlekileyo.
z-k-01-04.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba 지우 angaphendula njani umbuzo ngamnye ngempendulo emfutshane.
z-k-01-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ifumana ukuba izikhululo zibalwa njani?
z-k-01-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba 지우 angaphendula nganye ngempendulo emfutshane?
z-k-01-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ibiza intelekelelo yesalathiso, emva koko ukubala.
